tool_calls.input:
const compareCmd = `python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("tools").resolve()))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path.cwd()
task = root / ".ai/task/repair-w39-20260926"
items = json.loads((task / "WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
expected = {
    (x["normalized_path"], x["section"], x["source"], x.get("source_tag")):
    x["entry_revision_identity"]
    for x in items
}
assert len(items) == len(expected) == 27

runtime = LuaRuntime(load_manifest())
loader = LocaleLoader(runtime)
head_bytes = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "show", "HEAD:tome-orcs.lua"],
    cwd=root,
    check=True,
    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
).stdout
before = loader.load_bytes(head_bytes, logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations
after = loader.load_path(root / "tome-orcs.lua", logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations
assert len(before) == len(after) == 3904

changed = {}
targets = {}
stable = ("kind", "function_name", "section", "source", "source_tag", "args_order", "special")
for old, new in zip(before, after):
    assert all(old.get(k) == new.get(k) for k in stable), (new.get("line"), "non-target field")
    if old["target"] == new["target"]:
        continue
    key = ("tome-orcs.lua", new["section"], new["source"], new.get("source_tag"))
    revision = expected.get(key)
    assert revision is not None, (new.get("line"), "target outside workset")
    assert revision not in changed, revision
    item = next(x for x in items if x["entry_revision_identity"] == revision)
    assert old["target"] == item["target_preimage"], revision
    changed[revision] = key
    targets[revision] = new["target"]

assert len(changed) == 27
assert set(changed) == {x["entry_revision_identity"] for x in items}

confirmed = "43d64e16d118a6f700d7a08be2d864a5de274a9402354f4098e3b3a0f2678713"
wanted = "导弹命中目标，面板随之变暗，一场巨大的五彩爆炸透过窗户充满了你的视野。"
rejected = "导弹到达了目的地，巨大的爆炸堵塞了你透过窗户的视线，面板随之变暗。"
assert targets[confirmed].count(wanted) == 1
assert rejected not in targets[confirmed]

print(json.dumps({
    "verified": True,
    "runtime": runtime.doctor(),
    "baseline_translations": len(before),
    "current_translations": len(after),
    "changed_targets_relative_to_HEAD": len(changed),
    "workset_exact": True,
    "non_target_field_changes": 0,
    "confirmed_R2_target_exact": True,
}, ensure_ascii=False))
PY`;
const jobs = [
  ["LUAJIT_HEAD_COMPARE", compareCmd],
  ["STRICT_LINT", "python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict"],
  ["DIFF_CHECK", "git diff --check"],
];
const results = await Promise.all(jobs.map(async ([label, cmd]) => {
  const r = await tools.exec_command({
    cmd,
    workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
    yield_time_ms: 30000,
    max_output_tokens: 20000,
    sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
    justification: "允许我运行用户要求的最终有界验证：LuaJIT 相对 HEAD 的 27-target 比较、strict lint 与 git diff --check 吗？"
  });
  return [label, r];
}));
for (const [label, r] of results) text(`${label} EXIT ${r.exit_code}\n${r.output}`);
